history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me get back online?

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line was suspended, which is why you had no service or ability to send picture messages. I have now resumed your line, and your service should be restored.

Please reboot your phone to regain service. After restarting, you should see signal bars and be able to use your phone as normal, including sending picture messages.

If you still experience issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further troubleshoot.

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: I rebooted my phone, but I still don't see any signal bars and nothing is loading. I still can't send picture messages.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no service, let's troubleshoot your phone's connectivity step by step.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- “No Signal” or any signal bars
- Network type (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE)
- Any other unusual icons

If you’re not sure, I can guide you through checking this on your device. Would you like instructions on how to check your phone’s status bar?
I actually do see the airplane mode icon and 'No Signal' in my status bar. Data is enabled, and my battery is at 87%.

The Airplane mode icon means all wireless connections—including cellular service—are turned off, which explains why you have no signal.

Please turn off Airplane mode on your phone. Once it’s off, wait a few moments to see if your signal bars return. After that, check if you can send picture messages and access the internet.

Let me know if turning off Airplane mode restores your service. If not, we’ll continue troubleshooting.
Airplane mode is now off, but I still have no signal bars and can't use the internet or send picture messages.

Thank you for turning off Airplane mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Sometimes, the SIM card may not be properly seated or recognized, which can cause a complete loss of service.

Could you check your SIM card status on your phone? If you need instructions, I can guide you through the process. Alternatively, if you know how, please let me know what your phone reports for the SIM card status (e.g., active, missing, or locked).
My SIM card status shows as active, but I still don't have any signal bars and nothing is loading.

Thank you for checking your SIM card status. Since your SIM card is active and Airplane mode is off, but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your network mode settings. Sometimes, if your phone is set to use an unsupported or outdated network mode (like 2G/3G only), it can prevent you from connecting to the network.

Could you check your phone’s network mode preference and let me know what it is currently set to (e.g., 5G, 4G, 3G, 2G)? If you need instructions on how to check this, please let me know your phone model, and I can guide you through the steps.
My network mode preference is set to 4G/5G preferred, but I still have no signal bars and no service.

Thank you for confirming your network mode preference. Since your SIM card is active, Airplane mode is off, and your network mode is set correctly, but you still have no signal, let's try reseating your SIM card. This can resolve issues where the SIM is not making proper contact, even if it appears active.

Please remove your SIM card from your phone, wait a few seconds, and then reinsert it securely. After reinserting, wait for your phone to recognize the SIM and check if you regain signal bars and service.

Let me know if this restores your service, or if you still have no signal after reseating the SIM card.
I reseated the SIM card and my phone shows the SIM status as active, but I still have no signal bars, no service, and can't use data or send picture messages.

Thank you for following all the troubleshooting steps. Since your SIM card is active, Airplane mode is off, your network mode is set correctly, and reseating the SIM did not resolve the issue, but your line is active on our end, this may indicate a more complex technical problem with your device or network provisioning.

At this point, I will transfer you to a human agent who can provide advanced technical support and further investigate the issue.
